title: 28-year-old woman, 39 weeks pregnant, who collapsed
arrival: A 28-year-old woman, 39 weeks pregnant, presents after she collapsed while shopping.
feedbackWhy: She becomes unresponsive during the assessment. This is the first red criterion, and the patient should be moved to the high acuity area immediately.

unresponsive.text: Reports feeling tired and weak. Becomes unresponsive during the triage assessment.

airway_red.text: Breathing. No stridor. No central cyanosis.

disability_red.text: Not responding to voice. No convulsions.

other_red.text: Visibly pregnant with gravid uterus. No trauma or threatened limb.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: No vomiting or diarrhoea. No visible bleeding.

disability_yellow.text: Not responding to voice, so unable to report pain or walk.

other_yellow.text: Visibly pregnant with gravid uterus. No rash, deformity, fracture or dislocation.

exampleShows: Unresponsive is the first red criterion on the card.
Once it is met, you stop checking and move her to the high acuity area immediately.
